fft_tolerance_basis: N=1024 ordered PFFFT single-precision forward/inverse has about ten butterfly stages each way and float unit roundoff 2^-24; the source has 1024 weighting-loop iterations, of which 512 packed pairs are inverse-consumed. The source weighting maximum over the retained 80..20000-Hz domain is about 16.6 near 80 Hz. A 5e-4 V absolute floor (1e-4 of nominal 5 V peak) plus 3e-5 relative leaves room for accumulated transform/weighting order and cancellation across FFT backends in this bounded <=2-normal-input domain, declared before any result. Independent float64 canonical DFT selected block/time anchors use the corresponding 2.5e-4 raw filter-unit bound; no post-result widening.

Gray first completed block appears on connected gray step 1024; cursor and both buffers freeze while disconnected. Voss QUALITY=8 starts frame=-1, and wraps after frame255.
